intro.title: Cambridge Hospital
intro.subtitle: A Leader in Post-Acute and Rehabilitation Care
intro.lead: We are a specialized hospital for rehabilitation and long-term care in the GCC region.
text: At Cambridge Hospital, we provide comprehensive medical care and advanced rehabilitation services for patients requiring short-term recovery as well as long-term support for chronic conditions and complex injuries.

We deliver personalized care tailored to each patient’s needs, focusing on recovery, independence, and improved quality of life. We also encourage active involvement of family members as an integral part of the care journey.
